# Lacrosse features

The features a lacrosse surface is drawn from (`sportypy._feature_classes.lacrosse`).

## `BaseLacrosseFeature`

A lacrosse feature drawn by one of this module's shape functions.

`dims` holds the shape function's arguments (in the field's units).

## `FieldConstraint`

The field's in-bounds area (a rectangle, or an oval with rounded corners when `corner_radius` is set); constrains plotted data.
